::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 10th 1885  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell.
:::

Dear [Miss Manning](people/person_949.qmd)

[Miss Walter](people/person_1462.qmd) and I have much enjoyed reading [Miss Lawrence](people/person_2434.qmd)s' letter all the more as last Sunday evening [Mr Du Boulay](people/person_446.qmd) kindly came and talked to the parish about Madagascar.[^1]

If you will let me know in time, I will send you [the Daisy Chain](cmy_books/cmybook_24.qmd), [Trial](cmy_books/cmybook_53.qmd) and [Pillars of the House](cmy_books/cmybook_109.qmd)to send to her.  I am very glad to have the pleasure of doing so

with many thanks

yours truly

C M Yonge

---

[^1]: James du Boulay was a schoolmaster at Winchester College;  he was married to a sister of the Bishop of Madagascar.  The book dealer who sold the letter read it as 'Mrs du Boulay', but it looks to me like Mr. Either is possible.
